cohort: The participants were 120 full-term newborns, equally divided into groups of normal birth weight (>2500gms) and low birth weight (<2500gms), from whom placentas were collected.
finding: The study found that placental weight, volume, diameter, and thickness were lower in low birth weight full-term newborns compared to normal birth weight full-term newborns, with placental volume directly proportional to birth weight.
cross-section timing: Placentas were collected over 15 months from deliveries.
birth_weight: > 2500gms (normal birth weight group), <2500gms (low birth weight group)
